biography.value:
Human-elf, female, 27. This bodyguard was escorting travellers through the desert when Selyse first took control of her mind. Something bubbles beneath the surface of her glowing white eyes, desperate to break free.

Zephyr leads the road ambush and demands the party surrender their valuables — she has no choice. Mid-fight she desperately forces out the word "Help" and hands the nearest party member a hand-drawn map to the Bandit hideout; the geas punishes her immediately with psychic damage and she falls unconscious.

Afterwards she and her crew are left too weak to travel and too groggy to give further information of use. She is freed only when Selyse is defeated.

Stat block (SRD Spy)

Skills Deception +5, Insight +4, Investigation +5, Perception +6, Persuasion +5, Sleight of Hand +4, Stealth +4. Passive Perception 16.

Cunning Action. Bonus action Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

Sneak Attack (1/turn). Extra 7 (2d6) damage on a qualifying weapon attack.

Multiattack. Two melee attacks.

Shortsword. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

Hand Crossbow. +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

Table note: she is a victim, not a villain. Pull punches if the party is winning slowly — the scene wants her alive and unconscious, not dead.
